`create_model` computes `flat_snapshots` and converts snapshots for `n.model.parameters`, but never converts `sns` itself. Thus, for multi-period networks with `"flat"` (or `"auto"` under v1 semantics), variable and constraint builders—including the transmission-loss builders—still receive a MultiIndex rather than flat tuple labels; the component-data context does not change that argument.
